ai.title: CLI ads:enable and ads:disable commands show and rotate Gravity ads
ai.summary: Adds the /ads:enable and /ads:disable slash commands, backed by handleAdsEnable, handleAdsDisable, and getAdsEnabled in cli/src/commands/ads.ts, which persist an adsEnabled setting to settings.json. The chat UI now renders an AdBanner when an ad is available and ads are enabled, using useGravityAd to rotate ads every 60 seconds, pre-fetch the next ad 5 seconds ahead, stop after 3 ads without activity, and report activity on input and submit. The usage banner now shows ad-derived credits alongside free and paid balances. The web layer gains Next.js route handlers that serve ads from the Gravity API and grant credits on impression, with server-side storage in a new ad_impression table and a serverEnvSchema entry for GRAVITY_API_KEY.
ai.evidence: New file cli/src/commands/ads.ts exports handleAdsEnable, handleAdsDisable, getAdsEnabled; command-registry.ts imports and registers ads:enable and ads:disable commands; slash-commands.ts adds 'ads:enable' and 'ads:disable' entries to SLASH_COMMANDS; chat.tsx imports getAdsEnabled and AdBanner, filters slash commands based on adsEnabled, calls useGravityAd and reportActivity on input and submit; cli/package.json adds @gravity/api dependency; web/src/app/api/v1/ads/route.ts and web/src/app/api/v1/ads/impression/route.ts postAds, postAdImpression handlers added.
ai.migration: No migration is required, but existing users can run /ads:enable to start seeing contextual ads and earning credits from impressions.
ai.unknowns: The diff does not show the Gravity API response shape details or how the ad revenue share is configured server-side.

changes.what: Added ads:enable and ads:disable slash commands with handlers that toggle the adsEnabled setting, register them in command-registry.ts, list them in slash-commands.ts, and filter the suggested command list based on current ads state.
Introduced useGravityAd hook and AdBanner component to fetch, rotate, and render ads above the input, including activity-based pausing and credit display.
Added Next.js route handlers postAds and postAdImpression to serve Gravity ads and grant user credits on impression via processAndGrantCredit.
Added ad_impression table and migration to log served ads with payout and credit tracking.
Added 'ad' grant type and priority plus AnalyticsEvent for ad auth errors and usage display support.
Added required GRAVITY_API_KEY to serverEnvSchema and serverProcessEnv for ad serving.
